$comment: The platform features astryx-astro relies on, checked by scripts/baseline.mjs against the pinned web-features data and rendered into docs/platform.md (node scripts/baseline.mjs --write). use: required = may be used without a fallback (must be Baseline: web-features status low or high); enhancement = not Baseline, so feature-detected or harmless when unsupported (`degrades` says what happens without it). keys: compat keys (by_compat_key) that must be Baseline too; with partial: true only those keys count, because the feature as a whole is not Baseline.

Modal surfaces: Dialog, AlertDialog, Drawer, BottomSheet, Lightbox, MobileNav, CommandPalette (`showModal()`, `::backdrop`, `cancel`)
Dialog, Drawer, BottomSheet and MobileNav triggers and close buttons (`commandfor` + `command`, zero JS); the `command` event the hosts in `elements/dialog.ts` take over

features.note: position-visibility (anchors-visible/anchors-valid) is the part that is not Baseline; it is not used.

features.degrades: The value is invalid there and reads as `manual` (Astryx's fallback too); the tooltip runtime's group handoff closes the previous tooltip itself.

features.where: Dialog / Drawer / BottomSheet / MobileNav server markup (`closedby`), for zero-JS light dismiss
features.degrades: Before `elements/dialog.ts` runs, Escape closes even a `purpose="required"` dialog and a backdrop press does nothing; once it runs, its `cancel` handler and backdrop rule apply `purpose` in every engine (it switches `closedby="any"` to `closerequest` and takes backdrop presses over).

features.where: Closed Collapsible, TreeList and Banner content (`hidden="until-found"`, `beforematch`)
features.degrades: The content is plain `hidden`: find-in-page does not reveal it.

features.where: Collapsible and TreeList height animation (inside `@supports (interpolate-size: allow-keywords)`)
features.degrades: Content opens and closes without the height glide (the fade still runs).

features.where: `overlay` in the exit `transition-property` of layers and dialogs
features.degrades: A closing layer leaves the top layer at once, so its fade-out can paint below page content.

features.where: ScrollableArea's viewport is a scroll-state container (inside `@supports (container-type: scroll-state)`), for consumer `@container scroll-state(…)` rules
features.degrades: Such rules do not apply; the `data-scroll-*` edge flags the element writes still do.

features.where: Collapsible title and Text `capsize` (`text-box-trim` / `text-box-edge`)
features.degrades: Text keeps its half-leading: a few pixels of extra space above and below.
features.note: The two longhands used are Baseline per key (since 2026-08-18); the feature as a whole is not.

features.where: Text / Heading `textWrap="pretty"`
Layers, sheets, menus and scroll areas contain their scroll (`overscroll-behavior: contain`)
features.degrades: Scrolling past the end of a layer chains to the page behind it.

features.where: Non-selectable chrome (buttons, segments, handles, chips)
features.degrades: Safari needs the `-webkit-` prefix, written beside it where selection must stay off (Slider, ContextMenu); elsewhere the text stays selectable there.

features.where: The whole date/time stack through `lib/temporal.ts`: `lib/date`, Calendar, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput, TimeInput, Timestamp, Timer, PowerSearch and Table date values
features.degrades: Polyfilled, same behaviour: `lib/temporal.ts` imports `temporal-polyfill/full` (pinned 1.0.6, about 23 KB gzipped, all 16 calendar systems) on demand where `globalThis.Temporal` is missing (Safari, and Node during server rendering), without installing a global. Only pages with date components fetch it. Known difference: native ICU4X and the polyfill's Intl-based data put a few Chinese and Dangi month starts a day apart.

features.where: CodeBlock async tokenizing yields with `scheduler.yield()` (`lib/codeblock/tokenizer.ts`)
ChatDictationButton (feature-detected, `isSupported`)
features.degrades: The button is hidden (`isHiddenWhenUnsupported`, default) or rendered disabled.

features.where: `isApplePlatform()` (`elements/runtime/platform.ts`) reads `navigator.userAgentData.platform`: Kbd's ⌘ / Ctrl labels, hotkeys' `mod`, Slider's Ctrl+click rule
